integrity: Proof uses an explicit 81-state transfer matrix, an integer potential, and a reproducible entrywise integer matrix identity; finite brute-force enumeration is a cross-check, not the unrestricted proof. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the two lowest possible coefficient levels of the Roman-domination polynomial of cycle prisms, not a simplified formula for its full polynomial. No isomorphism-class/orbit classification is established. Older equivalent enumeration under other terminology is not excluded.
title: Exact low-weight Roman-domination coefficients of cycle prisms
